content: The gaming industry is notoriously secretive, and that's doubly true for anything related to Grand Theft Auto 6. Rockstar Games kept much of the game tightly under wraps, including one of the title's biggest secrets — a remarkable feat when you consider how much of the game leaked prior to launch. All of this might be true, but it didn't take the sting out of one husband's recent discovery about his wife's work on the record-breaking open-world title.
